comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Boarlet

Further Research Quest name: Further Research on Wild Boar
Skill requirement: r8 Ecological Research, r10 Biology, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: Tusks of a Giant Boar discovery (from "Hunting in Mythology" quest) + Wild Boar discovery (from "Wild boar map")
Required Sophia rank: 3
Sophia cost: 250 points
